description_for_human: Read monthly consumption and meter-reading data (heat, heat cost allocators, cold, warm and outdoor water) from messpunkt.io on behalf of a landlord. For German property-management ERPs and AI assistants.
description_for_model: API for reading sub-metering consumption data from messpunkt.io, a metering platform for German real estate. Use for questions about monthly consumption, month-end meter readings, meter replacements, or property / unit / measuring-point structure of a specific landlord's portfolio. Every endpoint requires an OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE access token; DPoP (RFC 9449) is optional. Access is Tenant-scoped AND per-Property (the token's property_scope claim lists allowed Property UUIDs or the literal 'all'). Always call GET /whoami after obtaining or refreshing a token to reconcile the accessible Property list. Out-of-scope resources return 404 (never 403) to avoid leaking Property existence. Data is monthly at the finest: consumption responses are nested per MeasuringPoint with DeviceSegment[] (meter replacements are explicit); each segment has one reading per calendar month end and a period_consumption block whose billable_value (raw consumption x factor) is the number to bill — sum it across segments, never bill last minus first reading. Status calibration_expired must not be billed. water_outdoor is not part of residents' water. obis, resolution and external_ref are always null. Responses contain no resident (Mieter) names or contact details. Landlords who want to use their own AI assistant should connect it to the MCP server https://mcp.messpunkt.io/v1 instead.

auth.instructions: OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE (S256 mandatory), resource=https://api.messpunkt.io (RFC 8707). DPoP (RFC 9449) is optional; a token obtained with a DPoP proof must be used with a proof on every request. At consent time the landlord chooses all Properties (including future ones) or a selection; the resulting token carries a property_scope claim used to filter every response.
